description:
Re-root the workspace to another directory at runtime. Follows VENIRA_SECURITY_PROFILE: trusted/off (or VENIRA_UNRESTRICTED=1) switch anywhere existing; strict/balanced only inside VENIRA_WORKSPACE_ROOTS (unset = spawn only).
Use when: the client spawned the server once (e.g. Claude Desktop) and the user changed to a different project folder; switch instead of restarting the client.
Avoid when: one-shot tasks in the spawn directory, or under strict/balanced without VENIRA_WORKSPACE_ROOTS (the call is refused).
Output: workspace_root (the new root), allowed_roots. All subsequent path guards and caches operate on the new root.

root.description: Absolute path of the directory to make the workspace. Follows VENIRA_SECURITY_PROFILE: trusted/off switch to any existing directory; strict/balanced only inside VENIRA_WORKSPACE_ROOTS (unset = locked to the spawn workspace).
